BAh7CEkiCGdpZAY6BkVUSSI6Z2lkOi8vanVtcHN0.description:
Learn how to automate meetings with AI without stopping at basic meeting notes or summaries.

I asked AI to automate my meetings, and the part that actually worked was not just generating cleaner notes. The missing step was turning the meeting into a repeatable workflow: prep, captured notes, decisions, risks, action items, owners, follow-up drafts, human review, and tracked tasks.

In this video, I compare beginner AI meeting automation with a more advanced AI workflow that turns meeting notes into follow-through. If your team uses ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, or another AI tool to summarize meetings, this will show you why the notes are only the starting point.

Use the prompt linked below to map your own AI meeting workflow. But don’t stop at the prompt. Use it to define the structured record, review step, and destination for the work.
